spec: FinVerse spec v1.5 A8 (R4a confirmation of the selected design)

bands.label: 1-min volatility
bands.note: Std of 1-minute log returns. 1–2% a day over 389 minutes is 5.1–10.1 bps per minute.

bands.label: Daily volatility (across seeds)
bands.note: Std over seeds of the 09:30→16:00 log return. A large-cap moves about 1–2% a day.

bands.label: Return predictability |ac1|
bands.note: Lag-1 autocorrelation of 1-minute returns. Real prices are close to unpredictable (≈0).

bands.label: Variance ratio VR(5)
bands.note: Var of 5-min returns / (5 × var of 1-min returns). 1 = random walk; > 1 = the price trails a target.

bands.label: Volatility clustering (CS, PS)
bands.text: PASS CS ≥ 0.10 and PS > 0.03 · WARN CS 0.05–0.10, or CS ≥ 0.10 with PS ≤ 0.03
bands.note: CS = mean autocorrelation of |r| at lags 1–5, PS = at lags 10–30. Real markets: calm and wild periods cluster.

bands.label: Fat tails (excess kurtosis)
bands.note: Excess kurtosis of 1-minute returns. 0 for a normal distribution; real returns have fat tails.

bands.label: Volume–volatility correlation
bands.note: Spearman correlation of 5-minute realised volatility and volume. Real markets trade more when prices move.

bands.label: Spread (median, p95)
bands.text: PASS median ≤ 2.5 and p95 ≤ 10 bps · WARN p95 ≤ 25 bps
bands.note: Bid-ask spread in bps of the mid, two-sided seconds only (spec v1.4.1: the v1.3 tick band was a unit error; liquid large caps trade at about 1–2.5 bps, Nasdaq).

bands.label: Mispricing size (gap std)
bands.note: Std of price − true value. Real prices wander around value by dollars, not cents.

bands.label: Mispricing half-life
bands.text: PASS 30–90 min · WARN 10–30 or 90–180 min · FAIL otherwise or none
bands.note: How long a mispricing takes to halve (spring model, lags 1–60 min, corrected reading, spec v1.4 §3.1). Real mispricings last much longer than minutes.

bands.label: Regime contrast
bands.text: REPORTED, not graded (spec v1.5 A6.4; was PASS ≥ 5 · WARN 3–5)
bands.note: Wildest / calmest 30-min volatility. Sampling noise alone gives about 1.55. One day of 13 half-hours mostly measures the intraday U-shape and noise (even the true value gives 2.4–2.9), so regimes are graded across days (RS).

bands.label: Impact exponent β
bands.note: Slope of log impact on log order size (share of daily volume). The square-root law gives 0.5.

bands.label: Impact recovery I_perm / I_peak
bands.note: Share of the peak impact still present 25–35 min after the order ends. Real impact partly decays.

baseline_label: The v1.5 default market R-25M15003: living_v1 value (auto day type, auto news), 60 informed fundamentalists D-60fl2M (informed_budget_v2), 12 momentum EKF, 1,500 retail traders (κ_v 3), 2 market makers of $5M (ours), budget on, full day
